articles.headline: Jayson Tatum insists 'there's no beef' with Jaylen Brown in wake of trade
articles.description: Jayson Tatum spent most of his postgame news conference addressing speculation about his relationship with former Celtics teammate Jaylen Brown in the wake of Brown's shocking trade to Philadelphia over the summer.

images.name: Jayson Tatum (0) and guard Jaylen Brown [600x400]
images.caption: "At this point in our lives, we’re too old to be having our relationship discussed on the internet. If there’s a conversation to be had, we can definitely have the conversation," Jayson Tatum said, referring to the dynamic with Jaylen Brown.
